nom: PEACH & LILY The Good Acids Pore Toner

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combo skin report reduced congestion, smaller-looking pores, and better oil control without stripping.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally find it non-drying and hydrating-feeling, though one notes it is harsher than other toners on dry skin and needs a good moisturizer alongside it.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as gentle, non-stripping, and effective for reducing breakouts and pore appearance.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin repeatedly describe it as gentle with no burning, stinging, or redness, though a couple recommend easing in gradually since purging or irritation can occur with frequent use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to mid-50s report it works well despite assumptions the brand is not for mature skin, describing it as non-drying and effective on texture and tone.

concerns.aging: Reviewers over 45-53 report the toner is gentle and effective on mature skin, improving texture and tone without dryness; none report negative effects tied specifically to age.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it does not dry out or strip the skin and even feels hydrating; one reviewer explicitly notes it does not moisturize or add hydration back, and another finds it too harsh on dry skin.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report no redness or irritation, including on sensitive and reactive skin, with the toner described as calming rather than aggravating.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with cystic, reactive acne and a damaged barrier reports the toner never burns or worsens their skin; another with folliculitis reports quick improvement in skin quality.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading acne scars, more even-looking skin, and reduced dark marks over time; one reviewer is unsure if her twice-weekly use is enough to fade pregnancy-related dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer breakouts, cleared bumps, and reduced blackheads with regular use, including on tween, adult, and fungal acne; two reviewers report seeing no improvement in their skin at all.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the toner helps control oil production and reduces congestion without over-drying.

extraits.texte: This is my favorite skincare product that I've ever come across! At the beginning of my skincare journey I had very painful cystic reactive acne, and it was very hard for me to find a GENTLE but EFFECTIVE exfoliant that I could use daily. Even if I have an active breakout or a damaged skin barrier this toner has never and will never ever burn or make matters worse. I absolutely adore it and will be buying another soon.

This is the only BHA/AHA exfoliating toner I've found that gently exfoliates your skin in such a soft way to keep the skin looking and feeling softer and more radiant! This is one of my favorite toners especially since I have oily and acne-prone skin. So good. Make sure you're also using SPF everyday—especially with this product.

My skin is very sensitive so I started out using this product slowly not every day. It did not make my skin red, however my skin started to purge when used more frequently. So I use it x2 a week only. It gives a healthy glow and absorbs easily. It does not leave behind a sticky residue which is good. Very good exfoliant overall. I recommend it.

I use this to help with my acne scars and to help clear my skin when it has a breakout. It's a bit harsher then some of the other toners on my dry skin but it is still worth it and can easily be managed with the right moisturizer.
This is hands down the best toner I've ever used. It doesn't irritate my sensitive, combo skin or strip it dry. Clears up any acne and my skin feels so fresh afterward! I highly recommend.
Skin changes every few years, what i needed changed, it helped me with eczema …strong enough to do the work and delicate enough for sensitive skin.
This is suppose to be pore minimizing, but don't see it. Not astringent enough for my taste. I was using Clinque #2 . Will most likely go back.
